name: William's Shipment
summary: In Goldshire, William Pestle packs candles from Elwynn's kobolds for his brother Morgan in Stormwind.

sections.title: A Familial Trade
sections.body: William Pestle keeps trade moving between Goldshire and the capital. He gathers materials in Elwynn Forest, while his brother Morgan runs Pestle's Apothecary in Stormwind's Trade District. William cannot leave his duties to travel north, so he depends on couriers to carry the parcel of wax and candles into the city.

sections.title: Kobold Wax
sections.body: Kobold candles from Elwynn's mines fill the shipment. William gathers the large candles for their wax and packs them for Morgan at Pestle's Apothecary. The wax joins the stock used in the capital's alchemical trade.

faq.answer: The shipment holds candles gathered from kobolds in Elwynn Forest's mines. William collects them from passing adventurers and packs them as raw ingredients for his family's alchemy shop.

faq.q: Who is William sending this package to?
faq.answer: William sends the package to his brother, Morgan Pestle, who runs Pestle's Apothecary in Stormwind City's Trade District.

faq.q: Why does an apothecary need so many candles?
aliases: what does pestle do with candles
faq.answer: William says he and his brother need the large candles for their wax. He does not say which preparations will use it.

faq.q: Why doesn't William deliver the package himself?
aliases: why does william need a courier
faq.answer: William is busy managing his affairs and gathering goods in Goldshire, with no time for the overland trip to Stormwind. He hires travelers bound for the capital to carry the package.

angles.text: As a human, you can see how Goldshire's trade connects rural hamlets to the capital, Stormwind.
As an Alliance member, you help protect Elwynn's mines from kobolds and supply the capital's shops with raw alchemy goods.
